address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x40`.

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

channel_1.docs:
The configuration options for the 1st channel.

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

channel_2.docs:
The configuration options for the 2nd channel. Same options as 1st channel.

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

channel_3.docs:
The configuration options for the 3rd channel. Same options as 1st channel.

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

bus_voltage.docs:
Use the bus voltage (voltage of the high side contact) value on this channel in V. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

current.docs:
Use the current value on this channel in amperes. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

power.docs:
Use the power value on this channel in watts. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

shunt_resistance.docs:
**float**: The value of the shunt resistor on this channel for current calculation. Defaults to `0.1 ohm`.

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*

shunt_voltage.docs:
Use the shunt voltage (voltage across the shunt resistor) value on this channel in V. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [INA3221 3-Channel DC Current Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina3221#configuration-variables)*
